title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on the Issue of Special Agreements on the Place of Performance of Purchase and Sale Contracts

articles.content_en: I. The place of contract performance specially agreed upon by the supplier and the demander referred to in the replies of our court Fa (Jing) Fu [1985] No. 39 and [1988] No. 20 (respectively published in Issue No. 3 of 1985 and Issue No. 2 of 1988 of this journal) means the place of delivery expressly agreed upon by the parties in a sales contract, i.e., the place filled in the column for place of delivery or place of performance in the contract, or the place of delivery (place of goods handover, place of delivery) specified in the performance clause or other clauses of the contract. If the parties agree that delivery shall be completed only after installation, commissioning, or acceptance inspection at a certain place, such place of installation, commissioning, or acceptance inspection shall be the place of contract performance specially agreed upon by the parties. The place filled in the column for place of arrival (arrival station, arrival port, arrival destination) or place of acceptance inspection in the contract shall not be deemed as the place of contract performance specially agreed upon by the parties.

II. If the place of delivery expressly agreed upon by the parties in the contract is inconsistent with the provisions of other clauses of the contract, the place of delivery expressly agreed upon in the contract shall be the place of contract performance. Where the supplier and the demander have actually exchanged the goods, if the actual place of exchange is inconsistent with the place of delivery originally agreed upon in the contract, the People's Court, when exercising jurisdiction based on the place of contract performance, shall regard the actual place of goods exchange as the place of contract performance; however, this shall not affect the corresponding liability to be borne by the breaching party with respect to the place of delivery.

III. If the parties have not expressly agreed upon the place of delivery in the contract, the place of contract performance shall still be determined by distinguishing different methods of delivery in accordance with the provisions of the reply of our court Fa (Jing) Fu [1988] No. 20.
August 19, 1990
